drhp.business: Arvind Fashions Limited is one of India's leading lifestyle companies, bringing together a portfolio of iconic global and homegrown brands that span premium, mid-premium and youth fashion segments. The Company serves millions of consumers across categories, occasions and generations through brands like U.S. Polo Assn., Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein, Arrow, and Flying Machine. It operates an integrated omnichannel ecosystem comprising exclusive brand outlets, large format stores, multi-brand outlets, its own digital platforms, and leading online marketplaces.

sk.overview: India's organised retail comprises organised brick-and-mortar and e-commerce, with e-commerce the fastest-growing format. India retail was ~Rs 83 trillion in FY2025 (~21% organised) and is projected to reach Rs 123-135 trillion by FY2030. India e-commerce (including quick commerce) is ~Rs 6 trillion GMV (~US$70 billion) currently, projected to reach Rs 15-18 trillion (12-13% retail penetration) by FY2030.
